description.en: Gives a side of the next skill scene a fighting spirit: it writes the entry <side>_AVATAR (e.g. ATK_AVATAR) in the skill settings table. With mode 1 the value is avatarID; any other mode writes 0 (no spirit).
Side of the skill scene: "ATK" (attacking side) or "DEF" (defending side).
Fighting spirit number (read only with mode 1).
Always null (null if the script system is not ready, fewer than 2 arguments or the table set up for another scene kind: nothing is written).
